Tucker3-Direct forecast

Source: R/tucker3.R
tucker3_direct_forecast.Rd

Forecasts mortality by applying Tucker3 decomposition directly to log(mx). Pipeline: log(mx) -> Tucker3 -> forecast B-mode -> exp -> mx.

Usage

tucker3_direct_forecast(
  mx_array,
  years,
  h,
  R_A = 3,
  R_B = 3,
  R_C = 2,
  ts_method = "ets",
  fast = TRUE,
  return_full = FALSE
)

Arguments

mx_array

3D array [n_a x n_t x n_g] of mortality rates.

years

Integer vector of calendar years.

h

Integer forecast horizon.

R_A, R_B, R_C

Integer Tucker3 ranks for age, time, group modes.

ts_method

Time-series method for B-mode: "ets", "arima", or "rwd" (random walk with drift).

fast

Logical; use faster but approximate fitting?

return_full

Logical; if TRUE, return decomposition details.

Value

A list with mx_forecast and fit_pct.
